title: The Salt of The Earth
paragraphs: Do you know what the word salt means? Look, we are reading this. Jesus comes into the world and says, "The first message, you know, the first message." He presents the Beatitudes as qualities we should possess. We will let you know about that a little later. But at the end of that he says: "You are the salt of the earth." Do you know what salt means? Salt represents the elite standard. It doesn't mean seasoning. Did any of you think he meant seasoning? Are you following along with me?

Look, we think it means we're in a salt mine and we're shaking ourselves to season things. No, the word means elite. This is the meaning of the word in the Aramaic language that he used. He says: " What are you? You are the elite standard of the world. You are the ones who set the standards."
